section: C. Consumption, I=PAT, and Calculations (Week 3)
stem: (I=PAT Calculation) Assume the initial Environmental Quality (I) is 100. If Population (P) increases by 20% and the Level of Consumption (A) increases 2.5 times, by how many times must Technology (T) reduce its impact (decoupling) for Environmental Impact (I) to remain at 100?
stemId: Asumsikan Kualitas Lingkungan (I) awal adalah 100. Jika Populasi (P) meningkat sebesar 20% dan Tingkat Konsumsi (A) meningkat sebesar 2,5 kali lipat, berapa kali lipat Teknologi (T) harus mengurangi dampaknya (decoupling) agar Dampak Lingkungan (I) tetap 100?
calc: Calculation: $100 = (1.2 x P) x (2.5 x A) x (T / X); T = 3 / X. X= 3
calcId: [Perhitungan: $100 = (1.2 x P) x (2.5 x A) x (T / X); T = 3 / X. X= 3]
